name: Sengoku unification victory on the test map: raze, one castle missing, save/load, then all

steps.code: local limit=GameConfiguration.GetValue('GAME_TURN_LIMIT'); if limit~=DB.MakeHash('TURNLIMIT_NONE') then error('turn limit not NONE: '..tostring(limit)) end; return 'turn limit NONE after Create Game setup'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE']; if not marker then error('castle marker missing') end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker.Index) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total~=4 or total-owned~=2 then error('initial castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if not Game.IsVictoryEnabled('VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION') then error('unification victory disabled') end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('winner at start') end; return 'registered=4, two held by Date'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE'].Index; local target=nil; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if PlayerConfigurations[owner]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then local capital=Players[owner]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) and (not capital or city:GetID()~=capital:GetID()) then target=city end end end end; if not target then error('Date castle to raze missing') end; local owner,id=target:GetOwner(),target:GetID(); local how='DestroyCity'; if CityManager.DestroyCity then pcall(CityManager.DestroyCity,target) end; if CityManager.GetCity(owner,id) then how='fallback transfer (DestroyCity did not raze)'; CityManager.TransferCity(CityManager.GetCity(owner,id),0) end; return 'raze: '..how

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE']; if not marker then error('castle marker missing') end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker.Index) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=1 then error('negative castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one castle missing ('..owned..'/'..total..'); no winner'
ViewGeneric('VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION'); if Controls.GenericView:IsHidden() then error('custom victory tab hidden') end; return 'World Rankings shows 天下統一 condition'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE']; if not marker then error('castle marker missing') end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker.Index) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=1 then error('negative castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one castle missing ('..owned..'/'..total..'); no winner'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE']; if not marker then error('castle marker missing') end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker.Index) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=1 then error('negative castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if Game.GetWinningTeam()~=nil then error('victory with one castle missing') end; return 'negative: one castle missing ('..owned..'/'..total..'); no winner'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE'].Index; local last=nil; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if owner~=0 then for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker) then if last then error('more than one castle held out') end; last=city end end end end; if not last then error('held out castle missing') end; CityManager.TransferCity(last,0); return 'transferred the last castle'

local marker=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_REGISTERED_CASTLE']; if not marker then error('castle marker missing') end; local total=0; local owned=0; for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(marker.Index) then total=total+1; if owner==0 then owned=owned+1 end end end end; if total-owned~=0 then error('positive castles '..owned..'/'..total) end; if total~=3 then error('raze not verified: '..total..' castles remain') end; return '天下統一 with 3 of 4 castles after the raze'

local human=Game.GetLocalPlayer(); AutoplayManager.SetTurns(1); AutoplayManager.SetReturnAsPlayer(human); AutoplayManager.SetObserveAsPlayer(PlayerTypes.NONE); AutoplayManager.SetActive(true); return true

condition.code: local winner,v=Game.GetWinningTeam(); return winner==Players[0]:GetTeam() and v~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v]~=nil and GameInfo.Victories[v].VictoryType=='VICTORY_JAC_SENGOKU_UNIFICATION'
